slides.texte_overlay:
Things that make a man
look instantly put together
Clothes that actually fit. Shoulders in the right place, trousers at the right length. Fit matters more than brand or price, every single time.
Clean, simple shoes. White sneakers kept white, leather shoes polished. People look at your shoes more than you'd think. Get things tailored, it's cheap.
A fresh haircut every few weeks. A regular trim keeps you looking sharp even on the days you don't make much effort. Keep them clean, always.
Good posture. Shoulders back, head up, slow steps. The same outfit looks completely different on a man who stands tall. Book the next one before you leave.
Before: I looked fine but had little to say. After: five minutes a day of history, art or science, and I feel as sharp as I look. Every day.
slides.texte_sophia: Before: I looked fine but had little to say. After: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. I feel as sharp as I look.

slides.texte_overlay: A watch or one simple accessory. Not flashy, just chosen with care. One small detail shows you pay attention to how you present yourself.
A clean smell. Fresh shirt, deodorant, a light scent. Smelling good is the most underrated part of looking put together. Few men get it right.
